messages:
Ava (CS): FYI customer reports rerank returning all 0 scores + 422 in some pods. They claim payload uses 'documents' + an embedded query object inside each document.
Sofia (Support): can you paste the minimal payload they sent? i need to repro locally
Ava (CS): pasted below, they build the payload client-side and said their SDK flattened objects before sending.

```
POST /v1/rerank
{
  "documents": [
    {
      "id": "d1",
      "text": "first passage",
      "query": { "text": "what is the refund policy?" }   <-- BAD: query nested per-doc
    },
    { "id": "d2", "text": "second passage" }
  ]
}
```

Ava (CS): They said the response is 422 with message "invalid field: query in documents" for some requests, and in other requests the rerank completes but all scores are 0.
Sofia (Support): two separate bugs likely: (1) schema validation should reject nested query consistently, (2) if SDK silently moves query into wrong place the server may treat docs as candidates or apply fallback scoring leading to zeros.

Liam (Eng): quick notes from runtime side: the rerank endpoint expects a root-level "query" string (or root "query": {"text":...}) and either a "candidates" array of {id,text} or a "documents" array for passage-mode. If both are present weird behaviors can happen.
Liam (Eng): In particular, if the request contains "documents" that include unexpected extra objects (like nested "query" fields), our legacy parser in some older runtime shards used to coerce the shape into a candidate list and default scores to 0 when text couldn't be extracted. That explains the zero scores.
Ava (CS): ok will tell customer to move query to top-level. can we give them a minimal corrected payload?

Liam (Eng): yes — recommended minimal corrected payloads:

Correct (candidates):
```
POST /v1/rerank
{
  "query": "what is the refund policy?",
  "candidates": [
    { "id": "d1", "text": "first passage" },
    { "id": "d2", "text": "second passage" }
  ]
}
```

Correct (documents/passages):
```
POST /v1/rerank
{
  "query": { "text": "what is the refund policy?" },
  "documents": [
    { "id": "d1", "text": "first passage" },
    { "id": "d2", "text": "second passage" }
  ]
}
```

Liam (Eng): also callout: max candidates limit is 200 in this version; exceeding it will trigger validation or partial truncation depending on the shard. nested fields increase request size and sometimes hit payload-size parsing edgecases.
Sofia (Support): thanks. i asked customer to try corrected payload and to paste full headers + raw body if it still fails. asked them to include SDK version if using our client.
Ava (CS): customer replied — they were using an older community SDK that flattens objects into query-like fields when arrays present. they supplied the raw body showing query ended up inside each doc.

Ava (CS): can we get an eng check on whether we should hard-reject nested "query" fields in documents (instead of fallback behavior)? filing for consistency.
Liam (Eng): agree we should fail-fast. i will open an internal runtime issue and link it here. tagging @liam for follow-up. expected fix: strict schema validation on all shards + 422 message that clearly points to "move query to root or use candidates".

deploy-bot: deployment scheduled to staging for runtime patch at 2026-03-18T02:00:00Z :rocket:
Sofia (Support): great, i told customer we have a fix on staging and asked for a repro if they can test there. asked them to include example that previously produced zeros.
Ava (CS): customer will test and will update. thanks all :thumbsup:
